In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Cra No. 5542 of 2023
 (Santosh @ Tantu Dangi And Others Vs The State Of Madh
 Dated : 07-02-2025
 Shri Arjun Sharma - advocate for appellant No.1.
 Shri Vijay Sundaram, G.A. for respondent.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No. 2089 of 2025 which is an application on behalf of the appellant No.1 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The appellant has been convicted for offences punishable under Sections, 376 D of the IPC and section 3(2) (v) and 3(1)(w-i) of the SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and sentenced to RI for life, RI for life and RI for three years and total fine of Rs.21,000/- respectively with default stipulations.

entities.text: SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for respondent has opposed the present application by submitting that there are serious allegations against the appellant and therefore, the present application deserves to be rejected.
It is submission of the learned counsel for the appellant that the Trial Court erred in convicting the appellant and awarding the jail sentence.
It is further submitted that the Trial Court did not appreciate the evidence surfaced in the case and caused illegality /perversity.
Hearing of the appeal shall take some time and it is good case on merits.
The appellant has already suffered more than 7 years of jail incarceration.
Fine amount is stated to have been deposited.

Having heard the counsel for parties and keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case and that the appellant has completed more than 7 years of his jail sentence and the present appeal being of the year 2023, hearing of the same is likely to take a considerable time as presently the appeals of the years 2004-05 are being taken up for hearing, however, without commenting upon the merits of the case, we deem it appropriate to allow the present application.

It is ordered that the jail sentence imposed upon the appellant No. 1 Santosh alias Tantu Dangi shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he is directed to be released on bail on he furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousands only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this court on 14.04.2025 and thereafter on such other subsequent dates as may be fixed Santosh @ Tantu Dangi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56175213/
1 by the Registry in that behalf.
The is accordingly allowed and disposed of.
 (SURESH KUMAR KAIT) (ANAND PA  CHIEF JUSTICE JUDGE  MSP Santosh @ Tantu Dangi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56175213/
2
